warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.subtitle: Each one points to a rule and stays private between the person and the managers.
warnings.emptyBody: No warnings match this view. Good shifts make this list short.
warnings.newSubtitle: Person, rule, severity. Takes under 30 seconds.
warnings.searchPerson: Search a name or a role
warnings.noRulesTitle: No rules for this role yet
warnings.noRulesBody: Publish the rule set for this role in Setup first.
warnings.noteHelp: What happened, in a few words. The person will read it.
warnings.privacyNote: The person gets a notice without the content and reads it in the app. They can answer with their side.
warnings.sentBody: {name} will see it in the app and can answer.
warnings.respondHelp: Up to {max} characters. Your manager reads it.
warnings.ackDone: Thanks. Your manager sees you read it.
warnings.voidBody: A voided warning never counts. Possible within 24 hours, with a reason.
warnings.thresholdsBody: When a person moves to Attention, Follow-up or Review.

thHelp.windowDays: Only warnings inside this window count.

warnings.thFollow: {minor} or more minor, or {major} or more major.
warnings.thInvalid: Each step must need at least as many warnings as the one before.

messages.title: Messages
messages.emptyBody: Announcements from your managers will show up here.
messages.confirmAsk: Your manager asks you to confirm you read this.
messages.requireConfirmHelp: Each person taps I read it, and you see who did.
messages.sendHint: Pick at least one venue and write the title and message in English and Spanish.

pay.manageSubtitle: Propose a bonus or an award. It counts only once an approver switches it on.
pay.proposeBody: A captain's proposal goes to the manager. A manager's goes to the owner.
pay.reasonHelp: What it recognizes, in one sentence.
pay.noDeductions: Pay is never reduced for a warning or a mistake.
pay.nothingToApproveBody: New proposals from managers show up here.
pay.emptyBody: Recognize good work with a bonus or an award.
pay.ownerSubtitle: Rates, approvals and the monthly export for your payroll provider.
pay.exportBody: A CSV of the adjustments switched on in the month, for your payroll provider. They are marked as sent.
pay.reference: The First keeps a record and the approvals. Pay itself runs through your payroll provider.

stateHelp.up_to_date: No warnings in the last {days} days. Keep it up.
stateHelp.attention: A few notes in the last {days} days. Read them and you are back on track.
stateHelp.follow_up: Your manager will check in with you. Notes count for {days} days.
stateHelp.review: Your manager will meet with you. Notes count for {days} days.

me.recordEmptyBody: Nothing here. Notes from your manager would show up here, with the rule and how to do it right.
me.largeTextHelp: Makes every screen easier to read.
me.pushBody: Get messages and requests even when the app is closed.
me.pushInstall: On iPhone, install the app first: Share, then Add to Home Screen.
me.pushDenied: Notifications are blocked. Turn them on in your phone settings.

staff.title: Staff accounts
staff.subtitle: New people get a temporary password and choose their own at first sign-in.
staff.emptyBody: Add your team so they can sign in.
staff.name: Full name
staff.usernameHelp: 3 to 24 characters: letters, numbers, dot, dash. For example ana.p
staff.emailHelp: Only managers and owners use email to recover access.
staff.legalAge: Legal age to serve alcohol confirmed
staff.legalAgeRequired: Confirm the legal age to serve alcohol.
staff.deactivateHelp: Ends every session at once. Their records stay under their name.
staff.tempBody: Give it to {name} in person. They choose their own at first sign-in.
staff.tempOnce: It is shown only once. If it is lost, reset it again.
